access.deniedHint: Your account does not hold the loyalty member grant. Ask an administrator if you need it.
access.unreachableHint: Your access could not be checked, so this screen stays closed. Try again in a moment.

search.label: Look up a loyalty member
search.hint: A mobile number or a Loy ID — either one resolves the member.
search.noMatchHint: Neither a mobile number nor a Loy ID matched. Check the number and try again.
search.failed: The lookup could not be completed.

member.loadFailed: This member could not be loaded.

activities.caption: Most recent {{cap}} activities.
activities.atCap: There may be older activity not shown.
activities.empty: No loyalty activity for this member.
activities.failed: The loyalty activity could not be read.

sales.caption: Most recent {{cap}} sales lines.
sales.atCap: There may be older lines not shown.
sales.empty: No sales lines for this member.
sales.failed: The sales lines could not be read.

actions.empty: No actions recorded for this member.
actions.failed: The member actions could not be read.

status.dialogNote: Blocking records this reason against the member. It shows on the header and in the actions trail, and it is reversible from this same control.
status.reasonsFailed: The reasons could not be loaded.
status.reasonsEmpty: No blocked reason is available to choose. Nothing can be blocked until one is configured.
status.blockFailed: The member could not be blocked.
status.unblockFailed: The member could not be unblocked.

mobile.note: The mobile number is how this member signs in, and one of only two ways they can be found. It changes here, on its own, and never as part of a profile save.
mobile.label: New mobile number

problem.unchanged: That is the number this member already has, so there is nothing to change.
problem.notANumber: A mobile number is digits only. Check what was typed.

mobile.dialogNote: Check the new number before confirming. It replaces the one this member has now.
mobile.verifiedNote: The new number is recorded as verified straight away. No confirmation code is sent to the member, so this records your word for it rather than theirs.
mobile.changed: The member's mobile number was changed.
mobile.failed: The member's mobile number could not be changed.

profile.removalNote: Removing a contact detail takes away a way of reaching this customer. It is not account deletion.

removeEmail.none: This member has no email address to remove.
removeEmail.dialogNote: This stops the member being emailed at this address. Nothing else about them changes: their name, their national ID, their sign-in, their points, their tier and their whole purchase history all stay exactly as they are, and only the email address is cleared.
removeEmail.recordNote: The removal records your case reference, who ran it and when. It does not record the address being removed anywhere new.
removeEmail.removed: The member's email address was removed.
removeEmail.failed: The member's email address could not be removed.

removeMobile.none: This member has no mobile number to remove.
removeMobile.dialogNote: Removing the number is how a customer who has asked to be made unreachable is recorded as having asked. Read the three points below to the customer before you confirm.

consequence.signIn: The member will not be able to sign in. Signing in resolves by mobile number, and after this there is no number to resolve.
consequence.findable: The member will not be findable by mobile. Only the loyalty id will reach this record, and the member has no way to give it to us over the phone unless they have kept it.
consequence.keeps: Everything else about them stays. Their name, their national ID, their birth date, their points balance and their entire purchase history all remain, and stay readable to anyone holding the loyalty read grant.

removeMobile.blockNote: The member is also blocked, under a reason that records the removal as the customer’s own request. That reason cannot be chosen by hand, and it replaces any reason the member is blocked under now.
removeMobile.idHint: Type this member’s loyalty id, {{loyId}}, exactly as it appears. It is asked for because the number being removed belongs to whichever member is on this screen.
removeMobile.idRequired: Remove stays unavailable until the loyalty id is retyped.

problem.idMismatch: That is not this member's loyalty id.

removeMobile.removed: The member's mobile number was removed, and the member is blocked.
removeMobile.failed: The member's mobile number could not be removed.

invalid.email: That does not look like an email address.
invalid.birthDate: Enter the birth date as YYYY-MM-DD.

profile.fixFields: Some fields could not be sent as typed. Each is named below.
profile.staleTitle: This member changed while you had the form open.
profile.staleNote: Your edits are still here. Reloading replaces them with the member as stored now.
profile.updateFailed: The member's profile could not be updated.
profile.reloadFailed: The member could not be re-read, so nothing was replaced. Your edits are still here.

caseReference.label: Case reference
caseReference.hint: Name the customer's request — a case or ticket number, or how it reached you. It is shown on the actions trail, so keep the customer's own details out of it.
caseReference.required: Remove stays unavailable until a case reference is entered.

problem.tooLong: A case reference can be at most {{max}} characters.

refusal.invalidBlockedReason: That blocked reason was not accepted.
refusal.grant: This session no longer holds the authority for that command. Ask an administrator; retrying will not help.
refusal.memberChanged: This member changed since you opened the form, so nothing was written.
refusal.mobileAlreadyUsed: That number already belongs to another member, so nothing was changed. It has to be removed from that member before it can be used here.
refusal.sameMobile: That is already this member's number, so nothing was changed.
refusal.invalidMobile: That is not a valid mobile number, so nothing was changed.
